comments.note: In IconBuilder.php, the error constants (ERROR_PHP_ICON_FILE_NOT_FOUND, ERROR_JS_ICON_FILE_NOT_FOUND, ERROR_START_MARKER_NOT_FOUND, ERROR_WRITE_FAILED, ERROR_END_MARKER_NOT_FOUND) are declared out of logical order — ERROR_WRITE_FAILED appears before ERROR_END_MARKER_NOT_FOUND. While functionally fine, a sequential ordering (82301–82305 top-to-bottom) would improve readability. Recommend reordering in a follow-up.

insertIconCode() in IconBuilder.php reads file content with (string)file_get_contents() but does not check for a false return (unreadable file). The cast silently converts false to an empty string, which would cause a misleading 'start marker not found' error rather than a meaningful I/O error. Consider adding an explicit false-check similar to the file_put_contents guard already in place.

Not a blocking issue for this WP — the Developer noted this in their implementation observations. Consider a follow-up to add an explicit false-check.
